CREATE AN ORIGINAL 3D MULTIPLAYER GAME – GO CAR

Game Name: GO CAR

Tagline: Race Beyond Limits.

Create a complete, original, high-quality 3D multiplayer obstacle racing and survival game called GO CAR.

IMPORTANT: I want a fully playable game, not just a game concept, static design, prototype screenshot or non-functional UI.

The game should have the excitement and multiplayer obstacle-racing experience of popular party games, but it must have its own original identity, vehicle designs, maps, environments, animations, branding, mechanics and interface. Never copy existing game assets or maps.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

1. GAME STYLE AND WORLD
   ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

Create a beautiful, colourful, magical fantasy 3D world.

VISUAL STYLE:

- High-quality polished cartoon 3D graphics.
- Beautiful blue skies and fluffy white clouds.
- Floating fantasy islands.
- Green hills and colourful mountains.
- Waterfalls and magical gardens.
- Rainbow bridges.
- Giant colourful obstacle platforms.
- Candy-themed environments.
- Beautiful lighting, shadows and smooth animations.
- Bright, cheerful and visually attractive environments.

DO NOT create dark cyberpunk cities, industrial racing tracks, excessive neon environments or realistic car-racing worlds.

The game should look like a beautiful fantasy adventure.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
2. GAMEPLAY
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

- Cars-only gameplay.
- No walking or running characters.
- Third-person 3D camera behind the player's car.
- 20–32 players per match when multiplayer infrastructure supports it.
- Multiplayer obstacle survival racing.
- Multiple elimination rounds and one final round.
- Last surviving or qualifying cars advance.
- Exciting race countdowns.
- Real-time player positions.
- Smooth car movement and physics.
- Jumping, drifting, steering, acceleration and braking.
- Falling off the track eliminates a player.
- AI opponents for offline testing.
- Online multiplayer matchmaking when supported.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
3. UNIQUE GAME MECHANICS
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

Create original gameplay mechanics:

- Turbo Gates: temporarily increase car speed.
- Gravity Zones: change the gravity behaviour of cars.
- Energy Bridges: platforms that appear and disappear.
- Portal Roads: transport cars to other track sections.
- Moving Platforms.
- Rotating Obstacles.
- Giant Rolling Objects.
- Disappearing Roads.
- Jump Ramps.
- Drift Challenges.
- Temporary Shields.
- Speed Boosts.
- Creative Shortcuts.

Make every map exciting and different.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
4. MULTIPLE MAPS AND WORLDS
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

Create MANY unlockable and selectable maps.

Initial world ideas:

1. Cloud Kingdom – floating islands, clouds and rainbow roads.
2. Candy Kingdom – colourful candy roads and sweet obstacles.
3. Jungle Adventure – waterfalls, giant plants and wooden bridges.
4. Lava World – volcanoes, moving rocks and dangerous platforms.
5. Crystal Valley – magical crystals and beautiful landscapes.
6. Sky Paradise – floating castles and aerial obstacle tracks.
7. Ocean Adventure – underwater-inspired fantasy tracks.
8. Ice Kingdom – slippery roads and frozen obstacles.
9. Rainbow Valley – colourful bridges and moving platforms.
10. Mystery Island – secret paths and unpredictable challenges.

Every world should have multiple original tracks and different obstacle combinations.

Add map selection, map previews, map unlocking and random map selection.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
5. COMPLETE CAR COLLECTION SYSTEM
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

Cars are the main identity of GO CAR.

Create a large collection of original car designs.

CAR RARITY CATEGORIES:

1. Common
2. Uncommon
3. Rare
4. Epic
5. Legendary
6. Mythic
7. Secret / Ultra Rare

Each rarity should have distinctive designs, animations, visual effects and unlock requirements.

Create many different car designs, including:

- Cute cartoon cars.
- Sports-style mini cars.
- Monster-inspired cars.
- Candy-themed cars.
- Animal-inspired cars.
- Magical fantasy cars.
- Special event cars.
- Exclusive legendary cars.

Every car must have its own name, appearance, rarity and statistics.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
6. CAR LEVEL AND UPGRADE SYSTEM
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

Every car should have five upgrade levels:

Level 1 – Basic
Level 2 – Improved
Level 3 – Advanced
Level 4 – Pro
Level 5 – Master

Allow players to upgrade:

- Acceleration.
- Handling.
- Jump control.
- Boost recovery.

Use upgrade parts and earned game currency.

Keep competitive gameplay balanced so that rare or upgraded cars do not automatically guarantee victory.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
7. CAR CUSTOMISATION
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

Create a fully functional 3D garage.

Players should be able to customise:

- Car body designs.
- Paint colours.
- Colour combinations.
- Wheels and rims.
- Tyres.
- Spoilers.
- Body accessories.
- Magical trails.
- Boost effects.
- Horns.
- Victory effects.

Allow players to rotate and preview cars in 3D.

Players should be able to select, equip, upgrade and save their favourite car designs.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
8. CAR UNLOCKING SYSTEM
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

Players must have multiple ways to unlock cars and rewards.

A. QUEST SYSTEM

- Daily quests.
- Weekly quests.
- Special missions.
- Achievement missions.

B. LUCKY SPIN

- Free spin tickets earned through gameplay.
- Different reward rarities.
- Transparent reward probabilities.
- Car skins, tokens, coins and upgrade materials.

C. TOKEN SHOP

- Purchase specific cars using earned Car Tokens.
- Display car prices and unlock requirements.

D. TROPHY ROAD

- Earn trophies by playing matches.
- Unlock exclusive cars and rewards.

E. SPECIAL EVENTS

- Limited-time maps.
- Event missions.
- Exclusive car designs.
- Special trophies and rewards.

F. DAILY REWARDS

- Daily login rewards.
- Free coins.
- Spin tickets.
- Upgrade materials.

No real-money gambling or pay-to-win mechanics.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
9. GAME CURRENCIES
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

Create these separate currencies:

- Gold Coins: regular gameplay rewards.
- Gems: premium-style currency, also earnable through gameplay.
- Car Tokens: [REDACTED:secret] specific vehicles.
- Upgrade Parts: upgrade vehicles.
- Spin Tickets: use in the lucky spin.

Show balances clearly in the game interface.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
10. MULTIPLAYER AND GAME MODES
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

Create these game modes:

- Classic Survival Race.
- Elimination Challenge.
- Time Trial.
- Team Race.
- Private Room with friends.
- Special Event Mode.
- Final Championship.

Include matchmaking, player names, lobby, countdown, qualifying rounds, spectator mode and winner celebrations.

If online multiplayer requires a separate backend, create the architecture for it and clearly explain what needs to be connected. Do not pretend offline AI matches are real online multiplayer.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
11. MAIN MENU AND SCREENS
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

Create a beautiful professional mobile-game interface.

MAIN MENU:

- PLAY
- GARAGE
- MAPS
- SHOP
- LUCKY SPIN
- QUESTS
- EVENTS
- LEADERBOARD
- FRIENDS
- PROFILE
- SETTINGS

Also create:

- Loading screen.
- Matchmaking screen.
- Multiplayer lobby.
- Car selection screen.
- Map selection screen.
- Gameplay HUD.
- Round qualification screen.
- Elimination screen.
- Final round screen.
- Winner podium.
- Rewards screen.
- Car collection screen.
- Upgrade screen.
- Customisation screen.

All buttons should work wherever the underlying functionality is implemented.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
12. MOBILE CONTROLS
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

Optimise the game for Android mobile devices.

Include:

- Left steering button.
- Right steering button.
- Accelerate button.
- Brake button.
- Jump button.
- Boost button.

Add smooth responsive controls, camera following, sound effects and vibration settings.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
13. PROGRESSION AND REWARDS
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

Include:

- Player XP and levels.
- Player profiles.
- Match statistics.
- Wins and trophies.
- Achievement badges.
- Daily and weekly quests.
- Reward chests.
- Car collection progress.
- Leaderboards.
- Seasonal progression.
- Victory animations.
- Reward celebrations.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
14. SOUND AND ANIMATIONS
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

Add:

- Attractive background music.
- Engine sounds.
- Jump and landing sounds.
- Boost sounds.
- Collision sounds.
- Menu sound effects.
- Victory music.
- Smooth car animations.
- Exciting elimination animations.
- Beautiful reward animations.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
15. TECHNICAL REQUIREMENTS
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

- Build a real playable 3D game.
- Optimise for Android phones.
- Use smooth and responsive car physics.
- Optimise graphics and performance.
- Use modular architecture.
- Save player progress and unlocked rewards.
- Maintain currency balances and car upgrades.
- Create functional menus and navigation.
- Support expansion with more maps, cars and events.
- Implement secure multiplayer architecture where supported.
- Use original assets and original GO CAR branding.

IMPORTANT DEVELOPMENT PRIORITY:

First build a working main menu, a beautiful fantasy floating-island map, a controllable 3D car, mobile controls and basic race gameplay.

Then integrate the garage, car collection, rarity, upgrades, currencies, quests, spin wheel, map selection, rewards and multiplayer systems.

Do not create fake buttons or pretend that unsupported features are functional. Clearly identify any features requiring additional development or backend services.

FINAL GOAL:

GO CAR should become a complete, beautiful, colourful, original 3D multiplayer car obstacle-survival game with hundreds of possibilities for future cars, maps, events, rewards and customisation.

Make GO CAR feel like its own unique gaming universe.
